comparison.objective: Stops a sliding carton; candidate removes notched HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Intercepting and arresting a translating package differs from coaxial tool insertion, controlled bimanual striking, and small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Carton stoppage is title-supported; no thresholds/specs are available. Candidate requires four contact-loaded fractures, all fragments contained, and intact retained parts.
comparison.reason: Generic contact control is insufficient to establish overlap between arrest and fracture tasks.
